newsitem.title: USA: Universal Outdoor to buy billboard assets.
newsitem.headline: Universal Outdoor to buy billboard assets.

text.p: Universal Outdoor Holdings Inc said it has an option to acquire the assets of Tanner-Peck LLC after December 1 for $70.8 million in cash and 100,000 shares of Universal stock, including the $5 million option.
Both companies are in the advertising billboard business.

Universal said it intends to exercise the option and close the transaction before the end of the year. The option will expire December 31, the company said. Tanner-Peck operates 2,000 billboards in the Memphis, Tennessee, area.

Separately, Universal said it also entered into agreements to acquire 250 billboards from SRM Investments Inc in Dallas, Texas, for $5.8 million. In addition, Universal said it agreed to buy 150 billboards from Mountain Media Inc in southwestern Iowa for $1.8 million.
